title: Rust gRPC Worker Documentation Plugin

tag.description: Non-empty label attached to plugin-created metadata and runtime events.

observe.description: Controls the subscriber and all observability sanitizers.

enabled.description: Registers the subscriber and event, tool, and LLM observability sanitizers.

redact_keys.description: Object keys whose observability values are replaced recursively.

requests.description: Controls blocking and real request rewriting.

enabled.description: Registers tool and model policy plus request-rewriting middleware.

mode.description: Blocks configured tool and model names in enforce mode; permits them in observe mode.

blocked_tools.description: Exact tool names rejected in enforce mode.

blocked_models.description: Exact model names rejected in enforce mode.

header_name.description: Header name added to the real LLM request.

header_value.description: Header value added to the real LLM request.

priority.description: Priority for the tool and LLM request intercepts.

break_chain.description: Stops later request intercepts after this component rewrites a request.

execution.description: Controls tool, unary LLM, and streaming continuation wrappers.

enabled.description: Registers tool, unary LLM, and streaming LLM execution intercepts.

priority.description: Priority for all three execution intercepts.

emit_pending_marks.description: Adds Relay-owned pending marks to tool execution and LLM request outcomes.

runtime.description: Controls host marks, scopes, and isolated scope stacks.

emit_marks.description: Emits a host-runtime mark during the tool request intercept.

emit_isolated_scope.description: Creates, binds, and drops an isolated scope stack during the tool request intercept.
